newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Aug industrial output up 7.7 pct vs '95. [CORRECTED]
newsitem.headline: Argentine Aug industrial output up 7.7 pct vs '95. [CORRECTED]

text.p: Argentine industrial output was up 7.7 percent in August against the same month last year, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.
Nonseasonally-adjusted output was up 1.5 percent from July, and seasonally-adjusted output up 3.1 percent (corrects, reversing figures).
It was the fifth month in a row that output was above the level of the same month in 1995.

August output growth compared with a 5.0-percent rise in July from July last year. Nonseasonally-adjusted output jumped by 10.1 percent in July from June, while adjusted output slipped by 0.7 percent (corrects, reversing figures).
